p1.original: 在承担这本书的编写工作之初，我们几个参与者都没有意识到这项任务的重要性——然而，随着人们对数字化、多媒体内容的接受度一天天增强，这本书的编写工作的难度与重要性也指数级地增加。培生的内容经理卡莉·切赫（Carly Czech）出色地主导了整个过程，她不仅合理地安排了编写工作的流程，并且仔细地关注每一章的细节以及整本书的设计。同时，她还敦促整个团队的工作尽快步入正轨，并且在每一个转折点都提供相应的支持，确保我们的工作满足我们所制定的目标。项目经理米基·曼库斯（Mickey Mankus）一直跟进着我们的工作，在最后期限迫近时及时地提醒，并给予我们鼓励。执行编辑朱莉·凯利（Julie Kelly）敏锐的眼光确保了我们的文字严谨性且对学生来说通俗易懂，朱莉还在我们写作团队中针对每一章的内容进行了多次协调，以她特定的方式对所有的环节都做了有效的跟踪。在我们杰出的书稿结构设计者雷希达·帕特尔（Rashida Patel）和肖维塔·特里帕蒂（Shobhita Tripathi）的指导下，《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）的愿景变成了现实，他们使第8版成了我们期待中的经典。
p1.en: At the beginning of the work on the book, none of our participants was aware of the importance of the task — yet the difficulty and importance of its preparation has increased exponentially as acceptance of digital and multimedia content has grown. Carly Czech, the content manager in Pepsi, has led the whole process in an excellent way, not only by rationalizing the process of preparing the chapters, but also by carefully following the details of each chapter and the design of the book as a whole. At the same time, she urged the entire team to get on track as soon as possible and to provide commensurate support at every turning point to ensure that our work meets the goals we have set. The project manager, Mickey Mankus, has been following up on our work, reminding us in a timely manner when the deadline is approaching and encouraging us. The executive editor Julie Kelly's keenness ensures that our language is strict and understandable to students, and Julie has coordinated the content of each chapter on several occasions in our writing team, effectively tracking all the links in her particular way. Guided by our distinguished script designers Rashida Patel and Shobhita Tripathi, the vision of Zimbabwe General Psychology (8th edition) became a reality, making the 8th edition the classic that we expect.

p2.original: 将手稿制作成纸质和电子出版物的双重工作落到了负责生产的项目经理梅根·巴拉德瓦吉（Megha Bhardwaj）和我们的编辑克里斯蒂·兰登（Kristin Landon）身上，我们认为他们的工作完成得非常出色。认真细致的图片负责人珍·西蒙斯（Jen Simmons）给予的图片支持提升了本书的可读性。
p2.en: The dual task of producing manuscripts into paper and electronic publications falls on the project manager, Megha Bhardwaj, and on our editor, Kristin Landon, who, in our view, have accomplished a remarkable job. Photo support from Jen Simmons, the careful photo director, has improved the readability of the book.

p3.original: 我们认为应该将最珍贵的感谢留给我们的配偶、最亲密的同事和朋友，他们激励了我们，给予了我们所需的关爱与支持，并为我们提供了意见。菲利普要感谢他的妻子克里斯蒂娜·马斯拉赫（Christina Maslach），感谢她无尽的灵感和对本书内容构想的建议。菲利普已跨过了教授心理学入门类课程50年的里程碑，他推广心理学的方式从研讨会到面向1000多名学生的大型讲座，可谓是多种多样，今天他仍在美国和海外的大学及高中进行着心理学科普。他一直从讲课以及把学生们带入心理学世界的乐趣和魅力中获得快乐。他被几代学生赞誉为“心理学的摇滚明星”，在这些学生中，有很多人是看着他的《探索心理学》（Discovering Psychology）节目长大的。
p3.en: We believe that the most precious thanks should be given to our spouses, our closest colleagues and friends, who inspired us, gave us the care and support we needed and provided us with advice. Philip would like to thank her wife, Christina Maslach, for her endless inspiration and advice on the concept of the content of the book. Philip has passed the 50-year milestone of teaching an introductory course in psychology, and he has promoted psychology in a variety of ways, from seminars to large lectures for more than 1,000 students, and he is still working in psychology at universities and high schools in the United States and abroad today. He has always enjoyed his lectures and the pleasure and charm of bringing students into the world of psychology. He was hailed by several generations of students as a “rock star of psychology”, many of whom grew up watching his Discovering Psychology.

p4.original: 罗伯特很感激他的配偶、最好的朋友和最好的编辑米歇尔（Michelle），多年来她一直忍受着他在心理学话题上的夸夸其谈和对家务的置之不理，她的很多愿望都被延迟满足，但她几乎从不抱怨。她是理解和支持的提供者，也是最有帮助的评论家。罗伯特还要感谢他们的女儿丽贝卡（Rebecca），她让他将发展心理学应用在实践中。现在丽贝卡已获得社会学学士学位以及心理学研究生学位。此外，罗伯特还要感谢许多朋友，他们大多不是心理学家，但对于“心理学很有用”等版块总是能提出有趣的问题和建议。读者也可以在书中找到他们提出的主题，特别是在“本章思考题”和每章末尾的“批判性思维的应用”部分中。
p4.en: Robert was very grateful to his spouse, best friend and best editor Michelle, who for years had endured his rhetorical talk on psychological subjects and her disregard for housework, and many of her wishes had been delayed, but she had almost never complained. She is the provider of understanding and support and the most helpful commentator. Robert would also like to thank their daughter Rebecca, who has asked him to develop psychology in practice. Rebecca has now obtained a bachelor's degree in sociology and a postgraduate degree in psychology. In addition, Robert would like to thank many of his friends, who are mostly not psychologists, but who are always able to ask interesting questions and make suggestions for the “Psychological Use” section. Readers can also find the subjects they propose in the book, especially in the section “Throughts of this chapter” and “Application of critical thinking” at the end of each chapter.

p5.original: 薇薇安首先要感谢她的丈夫肖恩（Shawn），感谢他的爱和支持，以及在她面对压力时给予她顽童似的幽默感。她全职教学期间出了两本书，这是一个超乎想象的挑战（甚至是噩梦般的挑战），几个月来，肖恩和他们的儿子布莱兹（Blaze）一直在好奇薇薇安是否会从她的办公室里走出来！尽管如此，他们还是在薇薇安忙得昏天黑地时像比赛一样投入自己的工作、做家务、自娱自乐、与狗一起消磨时间和忍受吃快餐的痛苦。薇薇安也感谢多年来支持和鼓励她的学生、朋友和同事，以及执行编辑斯蒂芬·弗莱尔（Stephen Frail），是他建议薇薇安加入菲利普·津巴多和罗伯特·约翰逊的作者团队的。
p5.en: Vivian would like to begin by thanking her husband Shawn for her love and support and for giving her a childish sense of humor in the face of stress. Two books were produced during her full-time teaching, a challenge beyond imagination (even nightmares), and Sean and their son Blaze have been wondering if Vivian would come out of her office for months! Nevertheless, they are engaged in their own work, in housework, in their own pleasures, in time spent with dogs and in the pain of eating fast food in Vyvyan's dark. Vivian also thanked her students, friends and colleagues for supporting and encouraging her over the years, as well as the executive editor Stephen Frail, for recommending Vivian to join the author teams of Philip Zimbabwe and Robert Johnson.

p6.original: 许多心理学专家和普通心理学的授课教师也与我们分享了他们对《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）的建设性意见，他们是欧道明大学（Old Dominion University）的克里斯·布里尔（Chris Brill）、特拉华谷学院（Delaware Valley College）的艾莉森·巴斯柯克（Allison Buskirk）和科恩（Cohen）、米尔斯学院（Mills College）的克里斯蒂· 钟（Christie Chung）、长滩城市学院（Long Beach City College）的伊丽莎白·柯蒂斯（Elizabeth Curtis）、弗雷斯诺城市学院（Fresno City College）的琳达·德克吕夫（Linda DeKruif）、迈阿密大学（Miami University）的卡丽·E.霍尔（Carrie E. Hall）、奥斯汀州立大学（Austin State University）的杰里米·海德（Jeremy Heider）和斯蒂芬·F.（Stephen F.）、卡拉马祖谷社区学院的布赖恩·利特尔顿（Brian Littleton）、哈德孙县社区学院（Hudson County Community College）的莉莲·麦克马斯特（Lillian McMaster）、长滩城市学院的南希·梅鲁奇（Nancy Melucci）、得克萨斯大学布朗斯维尔分校（The University of Texas at Brownsville）的贾里德·蒙托亚（Jared Montoya）、欧道明大学的苏珊娜·莫罗（Suzanne Morrow）、奎斯塔学院（Cuesta Community College）的凯蒂·奈德哈特（Katy Neidhardt）、温斯洛普大学（Winthrop University）的唐娜· 纳尔逊（Donna Nelson）、加利福尼亚州多明尼加大学（Dominican University of California）的芭芭拉·诺娃（Barbara Nova）、潮水社区学院（Tidewater Community College;）的卡尔·奥斯特（Karl Oyster）、哈德孙县社区学院的西尔维娅·罗布（Sylvia Robb）、菲奇堡州立学院（Fitchburg State College）的希尔杜尔·席林（Hildur Schilling）、维吉尼亚卫斯理学院（Virginia Wesleyan College）的希拉里·斯特宾斯（Hilary Stebbins）、圣十字学院（Holy Cross College）的多丽丝·范·奥肯（Doris Van Auken）。
p6.en: Many psychologists and general psychology instructors also shared their constructive views on " General Psychology in Zimbabwe (8th ed.), Chris Brill of Old Dominion University, Allison Buskirk of Delaware Valley College and Cohen of Mills College, Christie Chung of Long Beach City College, Elizabeth Curtis of Florida City College, Inc. p7.original: 我们也感谢前几版《津巴多普通心理学》的审阅者，并希望他们了解他们对本书所有优秀内容所提的意见是多么宝贵。
p7.en: We also thank the readers of the previous editions of Zimbabwe General Psychology and hope that they will understand how valuable their comments on all the good contents of the book are.

p8.original: 最后，我们要感谢所有同事，他们的反馈使这本书完成得如此出色，也要感谢讲授这门课程的所有教师，感谢他们接受了教学上的挑战，并向学生传递了他们对心理学的热爱。
p8.en: In conclusion, we would like to thank all our colleagues, whose feedback has made the book so excellent, as well as all the teachers who have taught this course, for having accepted the challenges of teaching and for having conveyed to the students their passion for psychology.

p9.en: If you can make any suggestions for the next edition, we won't ignore it. Please contact us!
